name: quickbooks-online
description: QuickBooks works with Grok Bot to help you manage your business finances, get paid faster and keep key business tasks moving with bots that run on your schedule. See how your business is doing with profit and loss, cash flow, balance sheet, and accounts receivable and payable aging reports, plus sales by customer and product. Compare your profit, revenue, and expenses against similar businesses in your region. Create, send, and follow up on invoices and estimates, set up recurring invoices, and send payment links (US and Canada). Manage customers, products, and employees, review payslips, and preview your next payroll run. Import transactions from a CSV straight into QuickBooks, and get answers about QuickBooks Capital financing.
